title: Gida da iyali
description: Ten short, simple stories about home, family and everyday moments in Hausaland.

lessons.title: Gidan Audu
lessons.summary: Audu and his wife Binta live in a big house in Kano, and both of them love it.
lessons.text:
Wannan gida ne. Wannan gidan Audu ne. Gidan Audu yana Kano.

Audu mutum ne na Kano. Audu mai gida ne. Audu yana da mata. Matar Audu Binta ce. Audu da Binta mutanen Kano ne.

Gidan Audu babba ne. Wannan gida babba ne a Kano. Audu yana son gidan. Binta tana son gidan kuma. Audu yana gida a Kano, kuma Binta tana gida.

"Ina son wannan gida," Audu ya ce.

"Ina son gidan kuma," Binta ta ce. "Gida ne na Audu da Binta."

"Gidanmu babba ne," Audu ya ce.

Binta ta ce, "Gidanmu gida ne mai kyau."

Tambayoyi:
Wannan gidan wa ne?
Wannan gidan Audu ne.
Gidan Audu yana ina?
Gidan Audu yana Kano.
Matar Audu wa ce?
Matar Audu Binta ce.
Audu yana son gidan?
Audu yana son gidan, kuma Binta tana son gidan.

lessons.title: Aikin Kabiru
lessons.summary: Kabiru and his wife Ladi both work in Kaduna, and after work they are at home together.
lessons.text:
Kabiru mutum ne na Kaduna. Kabiru yana aiki a wani babban gida. Shi mai aiki ne. Shi ma yana son aiki.

Ladi matar Kabiru ce. Ita ma tana aiki. Ita ma mai aiki ce. Tana aiki a wani wuri a Kaduna.

Yanzu Kabiru yana aiki. Ladi ma tana aiki yanzu. Kabiru yana iya aiki da yawa. Ladi ma tana iya aiki da yawa.

Bayan aiki, Kabiru ya je gida. Bayan aiki, Ladi ma ta je gida. Yanzu su biyu suna gida tare.

"Aikin yana da yawa," Ladi ta ce.

"Haka ne," Kabiru ya ce. "Amma ina son aikina."

Tambayoyi:
Kabiru yana aiki a ina?
Kabiru yana aiki a wani babban gida.
Ladi tana aiki a ina?
Ladi tana aiki a wani wuri a Kaduna.
Bayan aiki, Kabiru da Ladi suna ina?
Bayan aiki, su biyu suna gida tare.
Aiki yana da yawa, amma Kabiru yana son aikinsa?
Haka ne, Kabiru yana son aikinsa.

lessons.title: 'Yan Garba
lessons.summary: Garba's son and daughter in Zaria love to play together in front of the house.
lessons.text:
Garba mutum ne na Zaria. Matar Garba Zainab ce. 'Yan Garba su biyu ne. Sunan ɗan Garba Bello. Sunan 'yar Garba Hadiza.

Bello shi ne na farko. Hadiza ita ce ta biyu. A gidan Garba, Bello ne na farko.

'Yan Garba suna son wasa. Duk rana suna wasa tare a gida. Duk rana Bello yana son wasa. Hadiza ma tana son wasa.

Wata rana, Garba ya ce, "Mu yi wasa tare!" Sai Garba da 'yansa suka yi wasa a gida. Wata rana kuma, Zainab ta yi wasa tare da su. Sai suka yi wasa da yawa.

"Mu 'yan Garba ne," Bello ya ce.

Tambayoyi:
'Yan Garba su nawa ne?
'Yan Garba su biyu ne.
Wa ne ɗan Garba?
Bello ne ɗan Garba.
Wa ce 'yar Garba?
Hadiza ce 'yar Garba.
'Yan Garba suna wasa a ina?
Suna wasa a gida.

lessons.title: Ruwa a gida
lessons.summary: There is no water at Usman's house, so he goes to get some and comes back home.
lessons.text:
Usman yana gida tare da matarsa Halima. Halima tana son yin aiki a gida. Amma babu ruwa a gida.

"Babu ruwa," Halima ta ce. "Ba zan iya yin aiki ba."

"Zan je, zan samu ruwa," Usman ya ce.

Usman ya je wani wuri. A wurin akwai ruwa da yawa. Akwai mutane da yawa a wurin, kuma mutanen suna samun ruwa.

Usman ma ya samu ruwa. Sai ya je gida da ruwan.

"Ga ruwa," Usman ya ce wa Halima.

Yanzu akwai ruwa a gida. Halima ta yi aikinta. Sai su biyu suka sha ruwa tare.

Tambayoyi:
Usman ya je ina?
Usman ya je wani wuri da akwai ruwa da yawa.
Akwai mutane a wurin?
Akwai mutane da yawa a wurin.
Usman ya ce wa Halima me?
Usman ya ce, "Ga ruwa."

lessons.title: Lokacin abinci
lessons.summary: Lawal comes home after work and waits until it is time to eat with Bilkisu.
lessons.text:
Lawal yana aiki duk rana, har lokacin abinci. Daga aiki, Lawal yana gida tare da matarsa Bilkisu.

"Bilkisu, lokacin abinci ne?" Lawal ya ce.

"Ba yanzu ba," Bilkisu ta ce. "Sai bayan wani lokaci. Ka zauna a nan."

Lawal yana nan a gida. Bayan wani lokaci, Bilkisu ta ce, "Yanzu lokacin abinci ne. Kai ma, ka ci."

Sai Lawal ya ci har ya ƙoshi. Bilkisu ma ta ci.

"Idan ina gida daga aiki, ina son in ci," Lawal ya ce. "Kuma ina son in ci tare da Bilkisu."

"Haka ne," Bilkisu ta ce. "Idan lokacin ya yi, za ka ci, kuma zan ci tare da kai. Za mu ci tare."

Tambayoyi:
Lawal yana aiki har yaushe?
Lawal yana aiki duk rana, har lokacin abinci.
Wa ya ce, "Lokacin abinci ne?"
Lawal ne ya ce haka.
Bayan wani lokaci, Bilkisu ta ce me?
Bilkisu ta ce, "Yanzu lokacin abinci ne."

lessons.title: Hanyar gidan Aminu
lessons.summary: Aminu shows a man the way to his house: go straight on, not back.
lessons.text:
Wata rana, wani mutum ya zo wajen Aminu. Mutumin bai san hanya ba.

"Ina hanyar gidan Aminu?" mutumin ya ce.

"Ni ne Aminu," Aminu ya ce. "Ni, gidana yana nan. Ka je ta wannan hanya. Ka je gaba, ba baya ba."

"Zan san gidan?" mutumin ya ce.

"Za ka san shi," Aminu ya ce. "Gida ne babba. A saman gidan akwai wani babban abu."

Mutumin ya je ta hanyar. Ya je gaba, ba baya ba. Sai ya ga babban gidan da babban abu a samansa. "Wannan ne gidan Aminu," ya ce.

Tambayoyi:
Mutumin ya zo wajen wa?
Mutumin ya zo wajen Aminu.
Aminu ya ce wa mutumin me?
Aminu ya ce, "Ka je gaba, ba baya ba."
Me akwai a saman gidan Aminu?
A saman gidan akwai wani babban abu.

lessons.title: Shekarar farko
lessons.summary: Nafisa begins her first year at school, and on the first day she finds a friend.
lessons.text:
Nafisa 'yar Katsina ce. Wannan ita ce shekararta ta farko a makaranta.

A ranar farko, Nafisa ba ta san kowa ba. Ta ce wa Hauwa, mahaifiyarta, "Ban san kowa a nan ba."

Hauwa ta ce, "Ke ma za ki samu wata. Ke 'yar Katsina ce, kuma a nan akwai 'yan Katsina da yawa."

A cikin makarantar, Nafisa ta ga Asabe. Asabe ma ba ta san kowa ba, saboda ita ma shekararta ta farko ce.

"Mu zama tare," Nafisa ta ce wa Asabe.

Yanzu Nafisa da Asabe suna tare. Duk rana suna zuwa makaranta tare. A cikin makarantar suna zama tare.

Tambayoyi:
Nafisa 'yar ina ce?
Nafisa 'yar Katsina ce.
Me ya sa Nafisa ba ta san kowa ba?
Saboda shekararta ta farko ce.
Me ya sa Asabe ma ba ta san kowa ba?
Saboda ita ma shekararta ta farko ce.
Nafisa da Asabe suna zuwa makaranta tare?
Haka ne, duk rana suna zuwa tare.

lessons.title: Shugaba Danjuma
lessons.summary: Danjuma is a boss at a big workplace, and his son Tanko wants to be like him.
lessons.text:
Danjuma shugaba ne a wani babban wurin aiki a Kano. Yana da babban matsayi a wurin. Mutane da yawa suna aiki tare da shi.

Ɗan Danjuma, Tanko, yana son ya zama kamar shi. "Ina son in zama shugaba kamar ka," Tanko ya ce.

"Domin ka zama shugaba, sai ka iya aiki," Danjuma ya ce. "Kuma domin ka samu matsayi, sai ka iya aiki tare da mutane. Wanda ba ya iya aiki tare da mutane ba zai zama shugaba ba."

Tanko ya ce, "Zan yi haka."

Daga ranar, Tanko yana aiki tare da mutane. Yana son ya samu matsayi kamar na Danjuma wata rana.

Tambayoyi:
Danjuma yana da wane matsayi?
Danjuma shugaba ne a wani babban wurin aiki.
Tanko yana son ya zama kamar wa?
Tanko yana son ya zama kamar Danjuma.
Wa ba zai zama shugaba ba?
Wanda ba ya iya aiki tare da mutane ba zai zama shugaba ba.

lessons.title: Ƙasar Maryam
lessons.summary: Maryam and her mother go to Sokoto, the land their family comes from, and spend the day there.
lessons.text:
Maryam 'yar Sokoto ce. Ita da mahaifiyarta Asabe suna Abuja yanzu.

Wata rana, Maryam ta ce, "Mu je ƙasar Sokoto."

"Mu je," Asabe ta ce. "Ƙasar Sokoto ƙasarmu ce. Ni ma 'yar Sokoto ce."

Sai suka je ƙasar Sokoto.

A Sokoto akwai mutane da yawa na gidansu. Duk mutanen sun zo wajen Maryam da Asabe. An yi wasa. Sai aka ci abinci. Duk rana sun yi wasa tare.

"Ina son ƙasar nan," Maryam ta ce. "Wata rana zan zo kuma."

Tambayoyi:
Maryam 'yar ina ce?
Maryam 'yar Sokoto ce.
Maryam da Asabe suna ina yanzu?
Suna Abuja yanzu.
Me aka yi a Sokoto?
An yi wasa, sai aka ci abinci.

lessons.title: Abin da Ibrahim yake so
lessons.summary: Ibrahim wants to work like his father, who shows his two sons how work is done.
lessons.text:
Ibrahim ɗan Yusuf ne. Yusuf yana da 'yan biyu, Ibrahim da Bello. Ibrahim yana son ya yi aiki kamar Yusuf. Abin da yake so ke nan.

Wata rana, Yusuf ya ce, "Ku zo wajen aikina. Ku ga yadda ake aiki."

Sai suka je tare, don su ga aikin. A wurin, Ibrahim ya ga yadda mutane suke aiki.

"Haka dai ake yin aiki," Yusuf ya ce. "Kun gani?"

"Mun gani," Ibrahim ya ce. "Na san cewa aiki yana da yawa. Amma dai ina son hakan."

Yusuf ya ce, "Ibrahim ko Bello, wa yake son aiki?"

"Ni ne," Ibrahim ya ce. "Zan yi hakan wata rana. Don haka zan fara yanzu."

Tambayoyi:
Ibrahim ko Bello, wa yake son aiki?
Ibrahim ne yake son aiki.
Yusuf ya ce wa 'yansa me?
Ya ce, "Ku ga yadda ake aiki."
Ibrahim ya san cewa me?
Ya san cewa aiki yana da yawa.
